category_title: Failing students who reject observation tasks and provide emotional feedback
minimal_context: The student is preparing to play a set of seven points in badminton against a partner and needs to declare a strategic target zone before starting.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Before you start this set of seven points, you need to declare your strategic project. Which target zone are you aiming for on the court?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hits the shuttlecock directly to the central zone of the opposing court) I'm just hitting it to the middle.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The task is to choose a specific zone, like the front or the back, before you play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do I have to tell him my plan? He's my opponent. I don't see the point of this pair work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just declare your strategic project so we can continue the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I'm not declaring any project. This is stupid and I'm not doing it.
